examples.english: He felt no compunction about canceling the meeting at the last minute.
examples.persian: او هیچ پشیمانی یا عذاب وجدانی از لغو جلسه در آخرین لحظه احساس نکرد.

miniContext: He felt no compunction about canceling the meeting at the last minute.

examples.english: After reviewing the evidence, the lawyer had to concede that his client was wrong.
examples.persian: پس از بررسی شواهد، وکیل مجبور شد بپذیرد که موکلش اشتباه کرده است.

miniContext: After reviewing the evidence, the lawyer had to concede that his client was wrong.

examples.english: A single spark from the campfire turned the dry forest into a raging conflagration.
examples.persian: یک جرقه از آتش اردوگاه، جنگل خشک را به آتش‌سوزی گسترده و شدیدی تبدیل کرد.

miniContext: A single spark from the campfire turned the dry forest into a raging conflagration.

examples.english: Without any real evidence, the theory remains pure conjecture.
examples.persian: بدون هیچ مدرک واقعی، این نظریه صرفاً یک حدس و گمان باقی می‌ماند.

miniContext: Without any real evidence, the theory remains pure conjecture.

examples.english: As a conscientious nurse, she double-checks every patient's medication.
examples.persian: او به‌عنوان یک پرستار وظیفه‌شناس، داروی هر بیمار را دوباره بررسی می‌کند.

miniContext: As a conscientious nurse, she double-checks every patient's medication.

examples.english: He gave a contemptuous smirk when his rival's plan failed.
examples.persian: وقتی نقشه رقیبش شکست خورد، او پوزخندی تحقیرآمیز زد.

miniContext: He gave a contemptuous smirk when his rival's plan failed.

examples.english: Her main contention was that the budget cuts would hurt small schools the most.
examples.persian: ادعای اصلی او این بود که کاهش بودجه بیشترین آسیب را به مدارس کوچک می‌زند.

miniContext: Her main contention was that the budget cuts would hurt small schools the most.

examples.english: The boy gave a contrite apology after breaking his neighbor's window.
examples.persian: پسر پس از شکستن پنجره همسایه‌اش، عذرخواهی پشیمانه و نادمانه‌ای کرد.

miniContext: The boy gave a contrite apology after breaking his neighbor's window.

examples.english: The journalist took copious notes during the three-hour interview.
examples.persian: خبرنگار در طول مصاحبه سه‌ساعته یادداشت‌های فراوانی برداشت.

miniContext: The journalist took copious notes during the three-hour interview.

examples.english: Two independent witnesses corroborated the driver's account of the accident.
examples.persian: دو شاهد مستقل، روایت راننده از تصادف را تأیید کردند.

miniContext: Two independent witnesses corroborated the driver's account of the accident.

examples.english: He left a cryptic note on the fridge that no one could understand.
examples.persian: او یادداشتی رمزآلود و مبهم روی یخچال گذاشت که هیچ‌کس نتوانست آن را بفهمد.

miniContext: He left a cryptic note on the fridge that no one could understand.

examples.english: A cursory glance at the report missed the error buried on page ten.
examples.persian: یک نگاه سطحی و سرسری به گزارش، اشتباهی را که در صفحه ده پنهان بود، از دست داد.

miniContext: A cursory glance at the report missed the error buried on page ten.

examples.english: The sheer size of the mountain did not daunt the experienced climbers.
examples.persian: بزرگی عظیم کوه، کوهنوردان باتجربه را مرعوب نکرد.

miniContext: The sheer size of the mountain did not daunt the experienced climbers.

examples.english: The long illness began to debilitate her once-strong immune system.
examples.persian: بیماری طولانی به‌تدریج سیستم ایمنی قدرتمند او را ضعیف کرد.

miniContext: The long illness began to debilitate her once-strong immune system.

examples.english: Guests at the royal dinner were expected to maintain strict decorum.
examples.persian: از مهمانان شام سلطنتی انتظار می‌رفت که نزاکت و رفتار شایسته‌ای را به‌دقت حفظ کنند.

miniContext: Guests at the royal dinner were expected to maintain strict decorum.

examples.english: Activists decried the factory's pollution of the local river.
examples.persian: فعالان، آلودگی رودخانه محلی توسط کارخانه را محکوم کردند.

miniContext: Activists decried the factory's pollution of the local river.

examples.english: The young lawyer spoke with deference to the senior judge.
examples.persian: وکیل جوان با احترام و ملاحظه با قاضی ارشد صحبت کرد.

miniContext: The young lawyer spoke with deference to the senior judge.

examples.english: Smoking has a well-documented deleterious effect on lung health.
examples.persian: سیگار کشیدن اثر زیان‌آوری کاملاً مستندشده بر سلامت ریه دارد.

miniContext: Smoking has a well-documented deleterious effect on lung health.

examples.english: Historians often study how a clever demagogue can manipulate public fear.
examples.persian: تاریخ‌نگاران اغلب بررسی می‌کنند که چگونه یک عوام‌فریب زیرک می‌تواند ترس عمومی را دستکاری کند.

miniContext: Historians often study how a clever demagogue can manipulate public fear.

examples.english: Critics derided the film for its weak plot and poor acting.
examples.persian: منتقدان این فیلم را به خاطر داستان ضعیف و بازی بد مسخره کردند.

miniContext: Critics derided the film for its weak plot and poor acting.

examples.english: She grew despondent after failing the exam for the second time.
examples.persian: او پس از قبول نشدن در امتحان برای بار دوم، ناامید و افسرده شد.

miniContext: She grew despondent after failing the exam for the second time.

examples.english: The fable has a clearly didactic purpose, teaching children about honesty.
examples.persian: این داستان تمثیلی هدفی واضح و آموزنده دارد و به کودکان درباره صداقت می‌آموزد.

miniContext: The fable has a clearly didactic purpose, teaching children about honesty.

examples.english: He was too diffident to raise his hand and ask the professor a question.
examples.persian: او آن‌قدر کم‌رو و فاقد اعتمادبه‌نفس بود که نتوانست دستش را بالا ببرد و از استاد سؤالی بپرسد.

miniContext: He was too diffident to raise his hand and ask the professor a question.

examples.english: The speaker kept digressing from the main topic into unrelated stories.
examples.persian: سخنران بارها از موضوع اصلی منحرف می‌شد و به داستان‌های نامرتبط می‌پرداخت.

miniContext: The speaker kept digressing from the main topic into unrelated stories.

examples.english: Being diligent about saving money helped her buy a house by thirty.
examples.persian: کوشا بودن در پس‌انداز به او کمک کرد تا پیش از سی‌سالگی خانه‌ای بخرد.

miniContext: Being diligent about saving money helped her buy a house by thirty.

examples.english: A discerning buyer will notice the flaws hidden under the fresh paint.
examples.persian: یک خریدار تیزبین و دقیق، عیب‌های پنهان زیر رنگ تازه را متوجه می‌شود.

miniContext: A discerning buyer will notice the flaws hidden under the fresh paint.

examples.english: She treated the cheap imitation with open disdain.
examples.persian: او با تحقیر و بی‌اعتنایی آشکار با آن تقلید ارزان‌قیمت رفتار کرد.

miniContext: She treated the cheap imitation with open disdain.

examples.english: He never disparages his competitors, even when he easily could.
examples.persian: او هرگز رقیبانش را تحقیر نمی‌کند، حتی وقتی به‌راحتی می‌تواند این کار را بکند.

miniContext: He never disparages his competitors, even when he easily could.

examples.english: The health ministry worked quickly to disseminate accurate information about the outbreak.
examples.persian: وزارت بهداشت به‌سرعت برای انتشار اطلاعات دقیق درباره شیوع بیماری اقدام کرد.

miniContext: The health ministry worked quickly to disseminate accurate information about the outbreak.

examples.english: He was so dogmatic about his diet that he refused to try any new food.
examples.persian: او درباره رژیم غذایی‌اش چنان متعصب و جزم‌اندیش بود که از امتحان کردن هر غذای جدیدی سر باز می‌زد.

miniContext: He was so dogmatic about his diet that he refused to try any new food.
